instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot at eye-level. On an outdoor grassy field with concrete structures in the background, two boys participate in a tug-of-war. On the left, the boy in the teal t-shirt and red headband (R2) leans low with his left leg extended, pulling a yellow rope with both hands. Behind him on the right, the boy in the striped t-shirt and patterned headband (R1) squats and pulls the same rope, smiling. They work together, pulling the rope in unison. On the far edges, cropped legs of other participants are partially visible. The scene is illuminated by bright natural daylight with vibrant green grass.
